records.source: I usually go to more positive movies, so this will be interesting.
records.translation: 我通常會看更正向的電影，所以這次應該會很有意思。

records.source: Yoba, please protect me from the dark energy of this movie.$7
records.translation: 尤巴，請保護我免受這部電影黑暗能量的侵襲。$7

records.source: Emily is whispering to herself...
records.translation: 艾蜜莉正在喃喃自語……

records.source: My energy levels are low after that one...$3
records.translation: 看完那部片後，我的能量水平變得很低……$3

records.source: Mmm... It's nice and warm in here. Winter is my favorite time to go to the movies.$h
records.translation: 嗯……這裡暖洋洋的。冬季是我最喜歡來看電影的時候。$h

records.source: That was very romantic.
records.translation: 真的非常浪漫。

records.source: Mmm... It's nice and warm in here. Winter is my favorite time to go to the movies.$h
records.translation: 嗯……這裡暖洋洋的。冬季是我最喜歡來看電影的時候。$h

records.source: I'm glad there was a good ending!
records.translation: 很高興結局很美好！

records.source: Oh, is this one of those 'fantasy' movies?$7
records.translation: 喔，這是那種「奇幻」電影嗎？$7

records.source: *yawn*... What? Oh... what was that movie about, again?$7
records.translation: *哈欠*……什麼？喔……那部電影又是在演什麼？$7

records.source: Everyone's talking about this movie, so I've been wanting to see it.
records.translation: 大家都在談論這部電影，所以我一直想看。

records.source: That last scene... what did they mean by that?
records.translation: 最後那一幕……他們到底想表達什麼？

records.source: Hey, @! I'm looking forward to this one... I hope we learn a lot!$h
records.translation: 嘿，@！我很期待這部電影……希望能學到很多東西！$h

records.source: Ah, I see... that's very interesting!
records.translation: 啊，原來如此……非常有意思！

records.source: Maru's taking notes!
records.translation: 瑪魯正在做筆記！

records.source: That was really interesting! I had no idea that so much life could be found in the big city.
records.translation: 真的很有意思！沒想到大城市裡竟然能找到這麼多生命。

records.source: It's a sci-fi movie, right? One of the things I like about sci-fi is seeing all the weird technologies they come up with.
records.translation: 這是科幻電影，對吧？我喜歡科幻片的原因之一，就是能看到他們想出的各種奇特科技。

records.source: Well, I've never seen anything like *that* through my telescope... but it was really great!$h
records.translation: 嗯，我從來沒有透過望遠鏡看到過*那種*東西……不過真的很棒！$h

records.source: I really like going to the theater, even if the movie's bad!$h
records.translation: 我真的很喜歡來電影院，就算電影很糟也一樣！$h

records.source: That was an interesting choice, for the final scene. What do you think they meant by that?
records.translation: 最後一幕的處理很有意思。你覺得他們想表達什麼？

records.source: Hey. I heard this movie is pretty grim... I'm looking forward to it.$h
records.translation: 嘿。聽說這部電影相當陰鬱……我很期待。$h

records.source: This cinematography is next-level.
records.translation: 這攝影水準簡直高出一個層次。

records.source: Sebastian has a grin on his face.
records.translation: 賽巴斯汀臉上露出笑容。

records.source: Best movie I've seen in a while... I wonder how they did some of those special effects?$h
records.translation: 這是我最近看過最棒的電影……不知道其中一些特效是怎麼做的？$h

records.source: *shrugs*... The movie poster looked pretty cool, so I'm in.
records.translation: *聳肩*……電影海報看起來挺酷，所以我願意看。

records.source: It wasn't the best ever, but I had a pretty good time... thanks for inviting me.
records.translation: 雖然不是史上最佳，不過我看得挺開心……謝謝你邀請我。

records.source: I hope it's short...
records.translation: 希望片長很短……

records.source: It's probably a fine movie for the target audience, but it's just not for me.
records.translation: 對目標觀眾而言，這大概是一部不錯的電影，只是不適合我。

records.source: I've been feeling kind of dull lately, so an action-packed movie is exactly what I need.
records.translation: 最近感覺有點沉悶，所以我正需要一部充滿動作場面的電影。

records.source: I'm all fired up, now! That was great.$h
records.translation: 我現在熱血沸騰！真的很棒。$h

records.source: I'm not sure what this movie's about, but I don't really care! It's just good to get out of the house.
records.translation: 我不確定這部電影在演什麼，不過也不在乎！能出門走走就很好。

records.source: That was a lot of fun, @. I'm glad we did this.
records.translation: 真的很有趣，@。很高興我們一起來了。

records.source: A short jaunt in the snow really gets the blood flowing.
records.translation: 在雪地裡短暫走一趟，真的能讓血液流動起來。

records.source: Longings of the heart...? Oh! You mean 'elevated levels of oxytocin in the limbic system'.
records.translation: 心中的渴望……？喔！你的意思是「邊緣系統中的催產素水平升高」。

records.source: Demetrius is furrowing his brow.
records.translation: 德米特里厄斯皺起眉頭。

records.source: The art of film has come a long way since those times, hasn't it?
records.translation: 從那個時代至今，電影藝術已經進步了許多，對吧？

records.source: This movie supposedly takes place in a 'futuristic' society... it will be interesting to see what that looks like!
records.translation: 據說這部電影的背景是一個「未來」社會……看看那會是什麼模樣，應該很有意思！

records.source: Great movie... but I wonder if there really is life beyond this planet?
records.translation: 很棒的電影……不過不知道這顆星球之外是否真的存在生命？

records.source: This one's right up my alley... you know I'm gonna love this.$h
records.translation: 這部電影正合我的胃口……你知道我一定會喜歡。$h

records.source: Technically, that's not correct...$3
records.translation: 嚴格來說，那並不正確……$3

records.source: Demetrius is scratching his chin...
records.translation: 德米特里厄斯正在搔下巴……

records.source: Well, they definitely embellished some things, but it was still mostly correct! Anyway, I had a good time.
records.translation: 嗯，他們確實誇大了一些內容，不過大致上仍然正確！總之，我看得很開心。

records.source: I read about this one in the paper... didn't seem like the thing for me. But I'll give it a shot.
records.translation: 我在報紙上讀過這部電影的介紹……感覺不太適合我。不過願意試著看看。

records.source: Nonsense! That was totally unscientific!$4
records.translation: 胡說八道！那完全不科學！$4
